player_prompt.intro:
E te Pulega {player_id} i se taalafouga o Pokeri Initia.
- 52 ipu; e vaai mai ia te oe le ipu a le malo.
- Ante {ante} sipi i le taimi o taalafouga, {max_rounds} taalafouga i le aofai.
- Mau aoga: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X o se numera faaopoopo e le silia i le toeititi o tupe aoga).
- Ipu maualalo e le o vaai mai ai e manumalo i le poti i le taimi o le faaiuga.

round.announce:
### Taalafouga {current_round}/{max_rounds}
Ipu a le malo o loo: {card}

invalid_move.ambiguous: Faamau mai se actione mo se ipu, faataitaiga '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', pe '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: E lē mafai ona [check] - o loo e feagai ma se peti.
invalid_move.amount_min: O le aofaiga o peti / siitia e tatau ona ≥ 1.
invalid_move.cannot_bet: E le mafai ona [bet] - e tatau ona [call] / [raise] / [fold].
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: E leai se mea e valaau ai; atonu o le a [check] naʻo oe.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Faaaoga le [bet X] e tatala ai; e leai se peti e siitia.

board.possible_actions: O au gaoioiga e mafai ona fai: {legal}
